Thanks for confirming slot — quick follow-up with the technical suggestions I'll present on the call so Anna / Sam have time to review: 

1) Access model recommendation (proposal):
- Provision a service account per environment (sandbox, staging, prod). Each service account gets a scoped API key with the minimum allowed scopes: inference.generate, inference.embedding (only if needed), and billing.read (for usage dashboards).
- Rotate keys via the Keys API every 30 days for sandbox, 90 days for prod. Use automated rotation in CI where possible.

2) Roles mapping (default):
- admin: full org admin (few people)
- engineer: deploy models, create projects, create service accounts
- viewer: read-only dashboards
- billing: see invoices and usage breakdowns

3) Suggested naming: verbio-svc-{env}-{purpose} (e.g., verbio-svc-prod-models).

4) Evidence & audit hooks:
- We'll provide an export of token issuance events and key rotation logs; security can request the SOC-2 evidence bundle through our security mailbox.

I'll share a short CSV that maps the above to specific API scope strings after the call.

— Sean Gallagher
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
